lines.text: An angel tells Joseph in a dream to flee to Egypt, and he takes the Child and Mary by night.
Joseph stays in Egypt until the death of Herod, fulfilling the words "Out of Egypt I called My Son."
Herod, filled with rage at being outwitted by the Magi, kills all the boys in Bethlehem two years old and under.
Jeremiah's words are fulfilled as a voice is heard in Gilead, with Rachel weeping for her children.
After Herod dies, Joseph returns to Israel, fears Archelaus in Judea, and settles in Capernaum in Galilee.
